hero.desc: Leo is built to help businesses run with confidence: customer data stays within Leo, issued documents are not silently erased or overwritten, and important changes remain traceable.
hero.cardDesc: Security is not only about access. It is also about preserving the history behind the decisions your business makes.
cardPoints: Customer data does not leave Leo for third-party profiling.
Issued documents remain available and auditable.
Corrections preserve evidence of what changed.

pillars.title: Your data stays yours
pillars.desc: Leo does not send your customer data elsewhere to build profiles or analyse people for third parties. Your operational data is there to run your business.

pillars.title: No silent deletion
pillars.desc: Issued receipts and documents should not disappear or be overwritten without a visible record. A correction is a new, traceable action—not a rewrite of history.

pillars.title: Built for accountability
pillars.desc: The right people can understand what happened, when it happened, and which action created the current record.

record.headline: A record you can stand behind.
record.desc: Business records matter after the sale is over. Leo’s approach is designed around authenticity, integrity, and legibility throughout the required retention period.
record.noteTitle: Legal corrections are different from deletion.
record.noteDesc: A document may need to be annulled or corrected through the legally appropriate process. That does not mean silently deleting the original record or replacing it without evidence.

steps.title: Preserve
steps.desc: Keep the original issued information available for the required archive period.

steps.title: Make visible
steps.desc: Show that a correction, cancellation, or other action took place.

steps.title: Trace
steps.desc: Keep enough context to understand the history behind the current state.

privacy.headline: No customer-data business on the side.
privacy.desc: Leo is software for operating your business, not a hidden analytics business built on your customers.
items: Customer data is used to support the services and workflows you choose to run with Leo.
Leo does not analyse or profile your customers for third parties.
We do not sell customer data or use it to create advertising audiences for other companies.
Access and retention should follow the role, purpose, and legal obligations that apply to the record.

fiscal.headline: Fiscal compliance is part of the product.
fiscal.desc: For Portuguese businesses, invoicing software must support the authenticity, integrity, and legibility of fiscal documents. Leo’s product commitment is aligned with that principle.
fiscal.coimaTitle: What is the risk of tampering?
fiscal.coimaDesc: RGIT Article 118 describes potential fines of €750 to €37,500 for deliberate falsification, concealment, destruction, or damage of fiscally relevant elements, including altering programs or data to reduce tax revenue.
fiscal.disclaimer: This is a potential legal range, not an automatic penalty. The applicable amount and legal classification depend on the facts, tax impact, and competent authorities. This page is product information, not legal advice.
fiscal.requirementDesc: Portuguese rules require fiscal information to remain authentic, integral, and legible during the archive period, and certified software must preserve evidence when information is changed.
